The Feathers Fly Part II#773.src: No one in Corkus ever made anything like this. Do you have anything to tell us, or show?
The Feathers Fly Part II#773.dst: Niemand in Corkus hat je so etwas gebaut. Hast du uns etwas zu erzählen oder zu zeigen?
The Feathers Fly Part II#773.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#776.src: I... How do I put this...
The Feathers Fly Part II#776.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#777.src: I'm not exactly like you guys.
The Feathers Fly Part II#777.dst: Ich bin nicht ganz so wie Ihr.
The Feathers Fly Part II#777.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#780.src: What kind of prank is this?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#780.dst: Was soll das für ein Streich sein?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#780.speaker: Carl

The Feathers Fly Part II#785.src: What should we do what should we-
The Feathers Fly Part II#785.dst: Was machen wir was machen wir-
The Feathers Fly Part II#785.speaker: Mei

The Feathers Fly Part II#790.dst: Du hältst jetzt mal die KLAPPE!
The Feathers Fly Part II#790.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#793.src: Let's calm down and start ag-
The Feathers Fly Part II#793.dst: Beruhigen wir uns und fangen neu a-
The Feathers Fly Part II#793.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#795.src: Hmpf? Just take her on the spot!
The Feathers Fly Part II#795.dst: Hmpf? Nehmt sie doch gleich fest!
The Feathers Fly Part II#795.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#796.src: We wouldn't have known with such an outfit.
The Feathers Fly Part II#796.dst: Bei dem Outfit hätten wir es nie gemerkt.
The Feathers Fly Part II#796.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#797.src: There's only one thing I want to know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#797.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#798.src: Did you know, or did she trick you?
The Feathers Fly Part II#798.dst: Wusstest du es, oder hat sie dich reingelegt?
The Feathers Fly Part II#798.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#799.src: I swear {u} didn't know! Believe me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#799.dst: Ich schwöre, {u} wusste nichts! Glaubt mir!
The Feathers Fly Part II#799.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#800.src: Sure, and then what? What did you hope to accomplish?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#800.dst: Schön, und dann? Was wolltet ihr damit erreichen?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#800.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#801.src: I'm unsure if I should be impressed, distressed or enraged. So I think I'll just be all three! Ava, congratulations.
The Feathers Fly Part II#801.dst: Ich weiß nicht, ob ich beeindruckt, bestürzt oder wütend sein soll. Also bin ich einfach alles drei! Ava, Glückwunsch.
The Feathers Fly Part II#801.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#802.src: But... Why... I don't get it. I don't get the Avos. I don't get humans...
The Feathers Fly Part II#802.dst: Aber... Warum... Ich kapier's nicht. Nicht die Avos. Nicht die Menschen...
The Feathers Fly Part II#802.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#803.src: What's so wrong about me? Why shouldn't I do electromagic? Why??
The Feathers Fly Part II#803.dst: Was ist so falsch an mir? Warum soll ich keine Elektromagie nutzen? Warum??
The Feathers Fly Part II#803.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#804.src: Oh, darling. You impress then enrage me, and now you want me to pity you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#804.dst: Ach, Schätzchen. Erst Staunen, dann Zorn, und jetzt willst du mein Mitleid.
The Feathers Fly Part II#804.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#805.src: You know, your kind has always been...
The Feathers Fly Part II#805.dst: Weißt du, deinesgleichen war schon immer...
The Feathers Fly Part II#805.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#806.src: So archaic. Always with their spirituality, their flora, their beliefs, their traditions...
The Feathers Fly Part II#806.dst: So rückständig. Immer mit ihrer Spiritualität, ihren Pflanzen, ihrem Glauben, ihren Traditionen...
The Feathers Fly Part II#806.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#807.src: And you, you're fiddling not only with nature, but also with OUR things.
The Feathers Fly Part II#807.dst: Und du pfuschst nicht nur an der Natur herum, sondern auch an UNSEREN Sachen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#807.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#808.src: Somehow, you're able to control electromagic? I guess it's not exclusive to humans, then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#808.dst: Und irgendwie beherrschst du Elektromagie? Dann ist sie wohl nicht nur Menschen vorbehalten.
The Feathers Fly Part II#808.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#809.src: Even then, I see no reason as to why we should let you interact with us. You shouldn't be here.
The Feathers Fly Part II#809.dst: Trotzdem sehe ich keinen Grund, dich mit uns verkehren zu lassen. Du solltest nicht hier sein.
The Feathers Fly Part II#809.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#810.src: I think... I finally get it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#810.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#811.src: I do, really. The truth is...
The Feathers Fly Part II#811.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#814.src: I come up to you with an incredible breakthrough, and you can't even see past my feathers.
The Feathers Fly Part II#814.dst: Ich komme mit einem unglaublichen Durchbruch zu euch, und ihr seht nur meine Federn.
The Feathers Fly Part II#814.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#815.src: Alright, I've heard enough. That's it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#815.dst: Schön, ich hab genug gehört. Schluss jetzt.
The Feathers Fly Part II#815.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#817.src: Don't you dare touch- Gah! I'll show you. I'll show everyone what you're missing out on!
The Feathers Fly Part II#817.dst: Wag es ja nicht, mich anzufass- Gah! Ich zeig's euch. Ich zeig allen, was ihr verpasst!
The Feathers Fly Part II#817.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#818.src: What just... Everyone! Dismissed! What is that girl doing?! I'll go after her! Nodise, Maxie, you go and help Sybil!
The Feathers Fly Part II#818.dst: Was war... Alle! Sitzung beendet! Was macht dieses Mädchen?! Ich gehe ihr nach! Nodise, Maxie, ihr helft Sybil!
The Feathers Fly Part II#818.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#823.src: You're crying?! Aw... There, there. It's alright, you made it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#823.dst: Du weinst?! Ach... Na, na. Ist ja gut, du hast es geschafft.
The Feathers Fly Part II#823.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#902.src: God, I hate to say it, but her mask was flawless.
The Feathers Fly Part II#902.dst: Gott, ich sag's ungern, aber ihre Maske war makellos.
The Feathers Fly Part II#902.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#903.src: Flawless?! More like flawful! This was so obvious!
The Feathers Fly Part II#903.dst: Makellos?! Eher makelvoll! Das war doch so offensichtlich!
The Feathers Fly Part II#903.speaker: Dwice

The Feathers Fly Part II#904.src: And WHY didn't you say so??
The Feathers Fly Part II#904.dst: Und WARUM hast du nichts gesagt??
The Feathers Fly Part II#904.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#905.src: I- uh, y'know, didn't want to assume...
The Feathers Fly Part II#905.dst: Ich- äh, weißt du, wollte nichts unterstellen...
The Feathers Fly Part II#905.speaker: Dwice

The Feathers Fly Part II#906.src: Urgh. Look, there's only one think I want to know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#906.dst: Urgh. Hör zu, ich will nur eins wissen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#906.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#907.src: ... Did you know, or did she trick you? Be very careful about what you're about to say.
The Feathers Fly Part II#907.dst: ... Wusstest du es, oder hat sie dich reingelegt? Überleg dir gut, was du jetzt sagst.
The Feathers Fly Part II#907.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#932.src: I didn't really doubt you with your armour. We have a few questions though!
The Feathers Fly Part II#932.dst: Bei deiner Rüstung hatte ich kaum Zweifel an dir. Ein paar Fragen haben wir aber!
The Feathers Fly Part II#932.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#979.src: Huh, that armour's actually powerful. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'll show everyone what I'm really capable of.
The Feathers Fly Part II#979.dst: Hm, die Rüstung ist echt stark. Und jetzt entschuldigt mich, ich zeige allen, was ich wirklich kann.
The Feathers Fly Part II#979.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#982.src: Well... Mo'in, {u}. I was thinking about catching up with you and all after the audience, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#982.dst: Na ja... Mo'in, {u}. Ich wollte nach der Audienz eigentlich mit dir quatschen, aber...
The Feathers Fly Part II#982.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#983.src: I guess we don't really have time for that now, do we?
The Feathers Fly Part II#983.dst: Dafür haben wir jetzt wohl keine Zeit, was?
The Feathers Fly Part II#983.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#984.src: Wow, Maxie, great time management you got there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#984.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#985.src: Sybil... This is no time to quarrel.
The Feathers Fly Part II#985.dst: Sybil... Das ist nicht die Zeit für Streit.
The Feathers Fly Part II#985.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#986.src: Have you seen what just happened? I'm sure even now he'll keep defending the Avos!
The Feathers Fly Part II#986.dst: Hast du gesehen, was gerade passiert ist? Er verteidigt die Avos bestimmt sogar jetzt noch!
The Feathers Fly Part II#986.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#987.src: Look, there's no time right now. I think {u} and I should go and help.
The Feathers Fly Part II#987.dst: Hör zu, dafür ist keine Zeit. Ich finde, {u} und ich sollten helfen gehen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#987.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#988.src: Nodise... You probably should stay here too. We-
The Feathers Fly Part II#988.dst: Nodise... Du bleibst wohl besser auch hier. Wir-
The Feathers Fly Part II#988.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#989.src: Wha-What's happening?! Oh dear, I'll just run there!
The Feathers Fly Part II#989.dst: W-Was ist da los?! Oje, ich renn sofort hin!
The Feathers Fly Part II#989.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#990.src: Prevent Ava from making a mistake at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#990.dst: Hindere Ava bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] daran, einen Fehler zu begehen

The Feathers Fly Part II#991.src: Well look who decided to show up. I thought you would've fled by now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#991.dst: Sieh mal an, wer sich blicken lässt. Ich dachte, du wärst längst geflohen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#991.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#992.src: So what? Here to fix your mistakes? Help your insane bird friend?
The Feathers Fly Part II#992.dst: Und? Fehler ausbügeln? Deiner irren Vogelfreundin helfen?
The Feathers Fly Part II#992.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#993.src: For such a plant to grow in a few seconds... I can't believe this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#993.dst: Dass so eine Pflanze in Sekunden wächst... Ich fass es nicht.
The Feathers Fly Part II#993.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#994.src: Maxie's your friend, right? Well he's in there already. You should go, too.
The Feathers Fly Part II#994.dst: Maxie ist doch dein Freund, oder? Er ist schon drin. Du solltest auch hin.
The Feathers Fly Part II#994.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#995.src: I think you gotta reach the top to take care of this. Maybe multiple times.
The Feathers Fly Part II#995.dst: Ich glaub, du musst nach oben, um das zu regeln. Vielleicht mehrmals.
The Feathers Fly Part II#995.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#997.dst: Halte Ava bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] davon ab, {p} zu verwüsten

The Feathers Fly Part II#998.src: {u}!! I'm sure Efena told you already, no time to talk!
The Feathers Fly Part II#998.dst: {u}!! Efena hat's dir sicher schon gesagt, keine Zeit zum Reden!
The Feathers Fly Part II#998.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#999.src: Apparently, there's something up there! Try to reach the top! There are strange plants around, see if that helps!
The Feathers Fly Part II#999.dst: Da oben soll irgendwas sein! Versuch, nach oben zu kommen! Hier sind seltsame Pflanzen, vielleicht helfen die!
The Feathers Fly Part II#999.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.src: ...You're here. Here to fix my own mistakes, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.dst: ...Du bist da. Um meine Fehler auszubügeln, oder?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1000.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.src: And then, here to take me, I suppose. Right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.dst: Und dann, nehm ich an, um mich mitzunehmen. Oder?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1001.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.src: Y'know, I noticed you always were one to follow orders. Well, what you're lookin' for is on top of the plant.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.dst: Weißt du, mir ist aufgefallen, dass du immer brav Befehle befolgst. Was du suchst, ist oben auf der Pflanze.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.src: I... I'm not gonna fight back. There's no point. Just... Just go.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.dst: Ich... Ich wehr mich nicht. Hat keinen Sinn. Geh... Geh einfach.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.src: Woah! You did something! You should try that again!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.dst: Wow! Da hat sich was getan! Versuch das noch mal!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1004.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.src: I - I really didn't want this... I wanted to help people, {u}! Not... Not...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.dst: Ich - ich wollte das wirklich nicht. Ich wollte Leuten helfen, {u}! Nicht... nicht...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.src: I sure have impressed everyone. So I guess not all's lost, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.dst: Beeindruckt hab ich jedenfalls alle. Also ist nicht alles verloren, was?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.src: I'll be the talk of an entire nation!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.dst: Das ganze Land wird über mich reden!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.src: Gosh, I really am going crazy aren't I?...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.dst: Meine Güte, ich werd echt verrückt, oder?...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1008.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.src: I just... I don't know what to do... I reached rock bottom...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.dst: Ich... Ich weiß nicht, was ich tun soll... Ich bin ganz unten...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.src: I screwed up with my people, then with the humans, then...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.dst: Ich hab's bei meinem Volk vermasselt, dann bei den Menschen, dann...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.src: Could you tell her something for me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.dst: Kannst du ihr was von mir ausrichten?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1013.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.src: Tell her that... I'm not that mad.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.dst: Sag ihr... dass ich nicht so wütend bin.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1014.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.src: This... While destructive, it's impressive, and...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.dst: Das hier... Es ist zerstörerisch, aber beeindruckend, und...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1015.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.src: Whatever, just tell her! People will think I lost my mind, it's fine!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.dst: Egal, sag's ihr einfach! Die Leute halten mich für verrückt, schon gut!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1016.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.src: I'd like to talk to her. I assume she'll just flee, but... You should try!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.dst: Ich würde gern mit ihr reden. Sie flieht wohl einfach, aber... Versuch es!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1017.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.src: ...What? Do you have anythin' to tell me before I leave?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.dst: ...Was? Hast du mir noch was zu sagen, bevor ich gehe?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1018.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.src: Huh?! The president herself isn't too mad at me? What??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.dst: Hä?! Die Präsidentin selbst ist nicht allzu wütend auf mich? Was??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1019.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.src: Are you trying to make me get down and get arrested? You know I... I can't believe you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.dst: Willst du, dass ich runterkomme und verhaftet werde? Du weißt, ich... Ich fass es nicht...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1020.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.src: I want to, but... Have you seen how she was during the audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.dst: Ich will ja, aber... Hast du gesehen, wie sie bei der Audienz war?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1021.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.src: I can't trust you, {u}. There's no way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.dst: Ich kann dir nicht trauen, {u}. Auf keinen Fall.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1022.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.src: I regret this... I shouldn't have acted this way, this wasn't supposed to happen, I...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.dst: Ich bereue das... Ich hätte nicht so handeln sollen, das sollte nicht passieren, ich...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1023.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.src: I can't stay, {u}. The president's one thing, but the others... It's safe to say no one's gonna welcome me with open arms, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.dst: Ich kann nicht bleiben, {u}. Die Präsidentin ja, aber die anderen...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1024.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.src: No point fighting back, even though I could totally manage. I feel bad for that other girl now. Go, then... Stop my machine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.dst: Wehren bringt nichts, obwohl ich's locker könnte. Das andere Mädchen tut mir jetzt leid. Geh schon... Halt meine Maschine an.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1084.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.src: Hmpf. Did {u} take that thing down?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1108.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.src: Oh she better be around here!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.dst: Die ist besser noch hier irgendwo!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1111.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.src: Wait, under the rubble, I see something!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.dst: Moment, unter den Trümmern ist was!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1112.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.src: Look, I'll give you a mission. Find Ava with {u}, and tell her this...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.dst: Hör zu, ich geb dir einen Auftrag. Find Ava mit {u} und sag ihr Folgendes...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1116.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.src: Mo'in, {u}! You're fine! I'm so glad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.dst: Mo'in, {u}! Dir geht's gut! Ich bin so froh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1118.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.src: You're something of a hero, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.dst: Du bist ein echter Held, weißt du?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1119.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.src: That was some really nice job back there! But now...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.dst: Das war echt starke Arbeit eben! Aber jetzt...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1120.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.src: Well, the town's fine, but... I got tasked to find Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.dst: Na ja, der Stadt geht's gut, aber... Ich soll Ava finden.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1121.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.src: From what I've gathered, you worked with her and know where to go, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.dst: Wie ich hörte, hast du mit ihr gearbeitet und weißt, wo wir hinmüssen, oder?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1122.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.src: Oh, you told Ava about Efena? And she... she fled. Right. Well, I'm not surprised!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.dst: Oh, du hast Ava von Efena erzählt? Und sie... ist geflohen. Klar. Na, das überrascht mich nicht!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1123.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.src: Trust me, we want to help that poor Avo. Let's just find her, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.dst: Glaub mir, wir wollen der armen Avo helfen. Lass uns sie einfach finden, ja?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1124.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.src: Tell me whenever you're ready, and we'll go.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.dst: Sag Bescheid, wenn du bereit bist, dann gehen wir.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1125.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1128.src: Find Ava at the Workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#1128.dst: Finde Ava in der Werkstatt bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.src: The Avos chief did mention her once, but this place is crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.dst: Der Avos-Häuptling hat sie mal erwähnt, aber dieser Ort ist verrückt!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1130.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.src: You... I assume you're here to take me.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.dst: Ihr... Ihr seid wohl hier, um mich mitzunehmen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.src: Go ahead, then. Do it. I don't have anything to lose anymore. I've already lost everything.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.dst: Dann los. Tut es. Ich hab nichts mehr zu verlieren. Ich hab schon alles verloren.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1132.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.src: I don't want your pity. I have no one. You're making this harder for yourself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.dst: Ich will dein Mitleid nicht. Ich hab niemanden. Du machst es dir nur schwerer.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1134.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.src: The president didn't sentence you to death or anything... Quite the opposite, actually.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.dst: Die Präsidentin hat dich nicht zum Tode verurteilt oder so... Eher im Gegenteil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1135.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.src: What do you mean? Why should I trust you?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.dst: Was meinst du? Warum sollte ich dir trauen?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1137.dst: Na ja, es ist nur so, dass-
The Feathers Fly Part II#1137.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1138.src: Don't bother, Maxie. I'll explain myself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1138.dst: Lass gut sein, Maxie. Ich erkläre es selbst.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.src: Nice place. I can clearly see how our culture got to you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.dst: Schöner Ort. Unsere Kultur hat echt auf dich abgefärbt.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1139.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.src: So you're here. Are you... Forgiving me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.dst: Du bist also da. Vergibst du... mir?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.src: Oh, "forgive" is a really strong word, Ava. Look.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.dst: Ach, "vergeben" ist ein sehr großes Wort, Ava. Hör zu.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1141.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.src: I do believe we can all learn a thing or two about this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.dst: Ich glaube, wir alle können daraus etwas lernen. Ava...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1142.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.src: You broke the law, and as such, you're not allowed in town. Ya understand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.dst: Du hast das Gesetz gebrochen, deshalb darfst du nicht in die Stadt. Verstanden?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1143.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.src: First the Avos, then you, huh. So it's come full circle.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.dst: Erst die Avos, dann ihr, was. Damit schließt sich der Kreis.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1144.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.src: Look, that machine of yours is impressive. I'm not lying. You're talented.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.dst: Hör zu, deine Maschine ist beeindruckend. Ehrlich. Du hast Talent.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1145.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.src: But you've definitely made quite the mistake. I did too.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.dst: Aber du hast eindeutig einen ziemlichen Fehler gemacht. Ich auch.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1146.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.src: I guess you and I really learnt what "acting in the heat of the moment" means, huh.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.dst: Wir zwei haben wohl gelernt, was "im Eifer des Gefechts handeln" heißt, was?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1147.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.src: I have some sort of... Compromise. For us. Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.dst: Ich hab eine Art... Kompromiss. Für uns. Maxie?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1148.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.src: Yeah, I'm... interested in working with you. Learning from you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.dst: Ja, ich würde... gern mit dir arbeiten. Von dir lernen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1149.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.src: You're clearly better at Electromagic than I, so...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.dst: Du kannst Elektromagie eindeutig besser als ich, also...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1150.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.src: I'm willing to provide you with what you need. Help you out from time to time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.dst: Ich besorge dir gern, was du brauchst. Und helfe dir ab und zu aus.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1151.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.src: You've been alone for so long, Ava. I'm lending you Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.dst: Du warst so lange allein, Ava. Ich leih dir Maxie!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1152.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1153.src: Hey, don't say it like that!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1153.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.src: *chuckles* I'm kidding. The rest of the council isn't aware yet.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.dst: *kichert* Nur Spaß. Der Rest des Rats weiß noch nichts davon.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1154.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.src: They're not gonna like this, but I'll handle it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.dst: Das wird ihnen nicht gefallen, aber ich regel das.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1155.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.src: You know I can't kill you. Can you imagine how the Avos would take it? Even though you're banished...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.dst: Du weißt, ich kann dich nicht töten. Stell dir vor, wie die Avos das aufnähmen. Auch wenn du verbannt bist...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1156.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.src: But I don't want to either. As for you, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.dst: Aber ich will es auch nicht. Und was dich angeht, {u}...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1157.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.src: I'll give you some stuff. I can't imagine how things would've gone if it weren't for you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.dst: Ich geb dir ein paar Sachen. Ich mag mir nicht vorstellen, wie das ohne dich ausgegangen wäre.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1158.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.src: Now, you're banished from everyone Ava. I know that's no happy ending.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.dst: Nun bist du von allen verbannt, Ava. Ich weiß, das ist kein Happy End.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1159.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.src: But that would've been too easy, don't ya think?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.dst: Aber das wäre zu einfach gewesen, findest du nicht?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1160.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.src: Maybe later, you'll get your happy ending. But you can settle with not being alone anymore, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.dst: Vielleicht bekommst du später dein Happy End. Aber fürs Erste reicht es, nicht mehr allein zu sein, oder?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1161.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.dst: Leb wohl, Ava. Wer weiß, vielleicht schau ich mal vorbei.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1162.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.src: ...{u}? If you stop by the Workshop later, I'll set up something for you as well.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.dst: ...{u}? Wenn du später in der Werkstatt vorbeischaust, hab ich auch was für dich.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1163.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, maybe I'll stop by sometimes. After all, you're very stylish!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.dst: Leb wohl, Ava. Wer weiß, vielleicht schau ich mal vorbei. Du hast schließlich echt Stil!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1234.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.src: Goodbye, Ava. Who knows, I might stop by sometimes. Maybe you'll have figured out that armour of yours.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.dst: Leb wohl, Ava. Wer weiß, vielleicht schau ich mal vorbei. Bis dahin hast du deine Rüstung vielleicht durchschaut.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1270.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.src: Please contact Cerid for more information about this model.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.dst: Für weitere Infos zu diesem Modell bitte an Cerid wenden.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1273.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.src: If you have any questions, know that I am definitely not the right machine to ask.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.dst: Bei Fragen: Ich bin definitiv nicht die richtige Maschine dafür.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1274.speaker: Robot Sentry

The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.src: Hey, it's alright. We'll be fine.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.dst: Hey, ist schon gut. Wir schaffen das.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1276.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.src: You know, that Workshop of yours is way nicer than I expected.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.dst: Weißt du, deine Werkstatt ist viel schöner als erwartet.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1278.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.src: {u}, thanks for the help. You've introduced me to quite the talent!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.dst: {u}, danke für die Hilfe. Du hast mir ein echtes Talent vorgestellt!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1279.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.src: Believe me, I know how rejection feels like. I guess everyone does, in their own ways.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.dst: Glaub mir, ich weiß, wie sich Ablehnung anfühlt. Das kennt wohl jeder, auf seine Art.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1280.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.src: Efena... She's nicer than Chief, that's for sure...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.dst: Efena... Sie ist jedenfalls netter als der Häuptling...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1282.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.src: This is all... Very hard to believe.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.dst: Das ist alles... sehr schwer zu glauben.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1283.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.src: {u}, once you come back here, you'll be able to get some of my gadgets.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.dst: {u}, wenn du wiederkommst, kannst du ein paar meiner Apparate haben.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1285.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1289.src: You already got an outfit from this drawer.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1290.src: It has random clothes, but no real outfit.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1290.dst: Darin ist allerlei Kleidung, aber kein richtiges Outfit.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1293.src: You already picked up these clothes. Better find a way to wash them.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1296.src: You find a book about the history of Pirate Cove...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1297.src: You pet the dog. It's a good dog.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1298.src: You pet the dog again. It's still a good dog.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1299.src: You pet the dog again. Very enjoyable, yes.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1300.src: The dog has been pet again.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1302.src: The petting brakes broke. The dog is overjoyed.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1303.src: The dog, has been once again, pet.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1305.src: ...But apparently stopping isn't exactly an option.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1306.src: Or is it? Does free will exist? Or are we forced to forever pet a dog?

The Feathers Fly Part II#1307.src: It looks like there's only one unpleasant way to find out. And it's to stop petting the dog.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1308.src: Though, that's unlikely to happen. He's so cute!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1309.src: It looks like he'll be fine for a while now.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1310.src: But a few more pets won't hurt!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1312.src: The dog is content with your love. That should be enough.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1313.src: You might be able to wash the dirty clothes you found in there!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1317.src: You already picked up this bone.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1319.src: It's empty. You already found this chest.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1319.dst: Sie ist leer. Diese Truhe hast du schon gefunden.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1323.src: I'll try talking to more people!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1323.dst: Ich versuche, mit mehr Leuten zu reden!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1323.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1327.src: Do you think it'd work with that Mechanic outfit? Well, I don't think that matters anymore!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1327.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1329.src: Don't worry, we got this, let's keep looking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1329.dst: Keine Sorge, wir schaffen das, suchen wir weiter!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1329.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1333.src: And you booked an audience for tomorrow morning??
The Feathers Fly Part II#1333.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1348.src: It's all over. My life's over...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1348.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.src: We don't have that much time you know!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.dst: Wir haben nicht ewig Zeit, weißt du!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1357.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1358.src: Looks like there's an outfit ready right here!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1358.dst: Hier liegt wohl schon ein fertiges Outfit!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1360.src: You can give it to Ava, or you can look around the other rooms for more options.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1360.dst: Du kannst es Ava geben oder in den anderen Räumen nach weiteren suchen.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1361.src: There's some clothes here. They're dirty though.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1361.dst: Hier liegen ein paar Kleider. Sie sind aber schmutzig.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1363.src: There must be a way to wash those somewhere nearby.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1363.dst: Hier in der Nähe kann man die doch sicher irgendwo waschen.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1364.dst: Du beginnst, die Kleider zu waschen...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.src: Shoot, I think someone's coming!! Come back!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.dst: Mist, ich glaub, da kommt jemand!! Komm zurück!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1366.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1368.src: You take a look inside the drawer...

The Feathers Fly Part II#1369.src: Lucky! There's a Mechanic Outfit in there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1369.dst: Glück gehabt! Da drin ist ein Mechaniker-Outfit.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1371.src: You pick up a particularly tasty-looking bone.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1371.dst: Du hebst einen besonders lecker wirkenden Knochen auf.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1373.src: There's some sort of armour in that chest. It looks flashy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1373.dst: In der Truhe ist eine Art Rüstung. Sieht protzig aus!

The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.src: It's... Quite hard to move around with that outfit, actually.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.dst: Es ist... eigentlich ziemlich schwer, sich in dem Outfit zu bewegen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1378.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.src: ...Is that someone crying over there? Eh, I'm not sure my social skills can handle that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.dst: ...Weint da drüben jemand? Äh, ich weiß nicht, ob meine sozialen Fähigkeiten dafür reichen.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1379.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.src: Woah there, what's that letter? You actually got an invitation?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.dst: Hoppla, was ist das für ein Brief? Du hast echt eine Einladung?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1383.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1384.src: I... Wow. Well I'm impressed! I really am!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1384.dst: Ich... Wow. Ich bin beeindruckt! Wirklich!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1384.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.src: Did we even need a letter? That armour probably would've done the trick!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.dst: Brauchten wir überhaupt einen Brief? Die Rüstung hätte es wohl auch getan!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1385.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.src: Well... If you want me to follow you, tell me. I've heard 'bout a receptionist in the far end of the castle, so maybe we should go there?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.dst: Also... Wenn ich mitkommen soll, sag's mir. Hinten im Schloss soll eine Empfangsdame sein, vielleicht gehen wir da hin?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1386.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1387.dst: Na dann... Du gehst vor, ich folge!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1387.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.src: I heard there was a dealer around here but... We have the letter, so let's just keep goin'.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.dst: Hier soll ein Schieber sein, aber... Wir haben ja den Brief, also gehen wir einfach weiter.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1388.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.src: Well, no matter! I'll just... See when the council's available and book a meeting...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.dst: Na, egal! Ich seh einfach... nach, wann der Rat Zeit hat, und trage einen Termin ein...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1389.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.src: How peculiar. I wonder how they got that...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.dst: Wie seltsam. Wie man wohl daran gekommen ist...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1390.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.src: Hey! I saw you run towards the castle. What did you do?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.dst: Hey! Ich hab dich zum Schloss rennen sehen. Was hast du gemacht?
The Feathers Fly Part II#1391.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.src: ...Wait, what? You went to the receptionist alone, just like that?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.dst: ...Moment, was? Du warst einfach so allein bei der Empfangsdame?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1392.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.src: An audience is booked, and you didn't even give me the chance to show my cool armour!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.dst: Die Audienz ist gebucht, und du hast mich nicht mal meine coole Rüstung zeigen lassen!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1393.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.src: I... I'm really grateful. What a relief. I did some tweaking regarding the machine, so you should come and test with me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.dst: Ich... Ich bin dir echt dankbar. Was für eine Erleichterung. Ich hab an der Maschine rumgeschraubt, komm und teste sie mit mir!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1394.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.src: As I've said, this is only practice, don't worry.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.dst: Wie gesagt, das ist nur Übung, keine Sorge.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1395.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.src: Just tell me when you're up for another round!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.dst: Sag einfach, wenn du Lust auf noch eine Runde hast!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1396.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.src: You probably should wait for Ava first.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.dst: Du solltest wohl erst auf Ava warten.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1398.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.src: My guts are telling me this one's gonna be impressive. I hope he's there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.dst: Mein Bauch sagt mir, das wird beeindruckend. Hoffentlich ist er da.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1399.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1402.src: Looks like she's waiting for your signal.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1402.dst: Sie scheint auf dein Zeichen zu warten.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.src: I still can't believe this isn't about your armour.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.dst: Ich fass nicht, dass es nicht um deine Rüstung geht.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1405.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.src: No worries... Well, I'm worrying, but that doesn't mean you have to.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.dst: Keine Sorge... Na ja, ich mach mir Sorgen, aber du musst das ja nicht.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1406.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.src: Alright guys, don't worry... We got this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.dst: Okay, Leute, keine Sorge... Wir haben alles im Griff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1407.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.src: I'll just... wait for your signal, {u}.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1409.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1410.src: Hmpf. I certainly am curious now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1410.dst: Hmpf. Jetzt bin ich wirklich neugierig.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1410.speaker: Grant

The Feathers Fly Part II#1411.src: She's glancing at you. Maybe she's waiting for your signal.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1411.dst: Sie schielt zu dir. Vielleicht wartet sie auf dein Zeichen.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.src: EVERYONE! STOP! {u}, I want you to come here and answer something, immediately.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.dst: ALLE! STOPP! {u}, komm sofort her und beantworte mir eine Frage.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1413.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1414.src: You take a deep breath, and-
The Feathers Fly Part II#1414.speaker: Efena

The Feathers Fly Part II#1415.src: Looks like Maxie wants to speak to you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1415.dst: Maxie will wohl mit dir reden.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.src: You're- *cough* so good at handling... priorities, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.dst: Du kannst- *hust* so gut... Prioritäten setzen, Maxie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1416.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.src: Save your energy for later, Sybil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.dst: Spar dir deine Kraft für später, Sybil.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1417.speaker: Nodise

The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.src: Even after... Even after this, I'm sure *cough* he'll keep defending them...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.dst: Selbst nach... Selbst nach alldem wird er sie *hust* bestimmt noch verteidigen...
The Feathers Fly Part II#1418.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.src: You've been... *cough* tricked by... Quite the individual, {u}. You better redeem yourself.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.dst: Du wurdest... *hust* von einer echten... Type reingelegt, {u}. Mach das besser wieder gut.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1420.speaker: Sybil

The Feathers Fly Part II#1421.src: Efena doesn't seem very pleased to see you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1421.dst: Efena scheint nicht sehr erfreut, dich zu sehen.

The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.src: No time to talk, {u}! Just go! There must be a core to hit at the top!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.dst: Keine Zeit, {u}! Geh! Oben muss es einen Kern geben, den du triffst!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1423.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.src: Well, besides the citizens being afraid... I'd say the town's fine. However! I got tasked to find Ava.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.dst: Na ja, abgesehen davon, dass die Bürger Angst haben... geht's der Stadt gut. Aber! Ich soll Ava finden.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1424.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.src: Somehow... Efena ended up liking her.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.dst: Irgendwie... hat Efena sie am Ende gemocht.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1425.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1426.src: I'm reading, but I'll be done soon!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1426.dst: Ich lese gerade, bin aber gleich fertig!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1426.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.src: Y-you!! I- oh no... I'm... It's over..!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.dst: D-du!! Ich- oh nein... Ich bin... Es ist aus..!
The Feathers Fly Part II#1427.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.src: Hey, hey, calm down! I'm here to actually help you... in a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.dst: Hey, hey, beruhig dich! Ich will dir wirklich helfen... irgendwie.
The Feathers Fly Part II#1428.speaker: Efena
